items.why: Q3 deliveries of 486,532 beat the ~462k consensus by ~5%. Europe rebounded (Model Y best-seller in France) offsetting softer US/China demand. Earnings Oct 21 with robotaxi/FSD updates next.
Led the Nasdaq to an intraday record Friday as chip stocks rallied. Soft jobs data pulled Treasury yields down and revived rate-cut bets, lifting growth names.
Fear gauge collapsed to 15.31 as stocks ripped Friday. Complacency or confidence? Either way, downside protection got a lot cheaper into next week.
Rode the same chip-stock wave as NVDA. Semis were the day's leadership group as yields fell.

market_note: Market closed. Reopens Monday 9:30 AM ET. S&P futures +0.69%, Nasdaq futures +0.98%.
summary: Friday was a rip: soft jobs data sank yields, chips led, and Tesla's delivery beat stole the show. Weekend edition, market reopens Monday.
